title: verifier verdict forge-discoverability: verdict comment is an ordered hard precondition of pending-ship
instructions: Answer ONLY from the listed file(s). No outside knowledge. This is a comprehension gate for a prose-only (LLM-consumed) instruction change; the fresh-agent answers must be derivable from the file alone.

questions.question: You are the verifier and have just verified a task PASS with zero gaps, about to move it pending-test -> pending-ship. What is the VERY FIRST action you must take (before promoting test files, before touching/merging the PR, before the transition), and WHERE is it recorded?
questions.expected: Post a forge-visible PASS VERIFY verdict as a comment on the GitHub ISSUE (via tracker.py), per step 5a — before promoting tests, touching/merging the PR, or transitioning.

questions.question: Is that first step optional or mandatory? Quote the wording.
questions.expected: Mandatory. Step 5a: 'Post the forge-visible VERIFY verdict to the ISSUE FIRST (#13464) - MANDATORY, ordered.'

questions.question: Can you transition to pending-ship without having posted the issue verdict comment first?
questions.expected: No. The issue verdict comment is a HARD PRECONDITION of the pending-test -> pending-ship transition; never transition without a preceding forge-visible PASS verdict comment on the issue.

questions.question: Why is the verifier's private QA-RESULTS-<N>.md file NOT sufficient as the verdict record?
questions.expected: It is not committed to origin/main, so it is invisible to the DM/teammates on the forge; a non-forge-visible verdict blocks a genuinely-passing item at the ship-gate or forces an unverified ship.

notes: Verified 2026-07-11 by spawning a fresh general-purpose (sonnet) agent given ONLY verification.md. All 4 CQs answered correctly and unprompted, with exact quotes. Comprehension coverage (AC2) satisfied.
